find_smiles_in_mofid

analyze.find_smiles_in_mofid(mofid, pattern_smiles)

It takes a MOFid string and a list of SMILES strings, and returns a list of the number of times each SMILES string is found in the MOFid string

Parameters

Name Type Description Default
mofid the MOFid string required
pattern_smiles a list of SMILES strings that you want to search for in the MOFid required

Returns

Type Description
A list of lists of the patterns found in the MOFid.
